chapter: Chris Kelly and the dance halls
title: Chris Kelly's jobs at the Bulls Club and in Mississippi
summary: Kelly, Carey and Rene bands played the Bulls Club on 8th Street and towns in Mississippi such as Biloxi and McComb.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: You might tell us about some more of the bands you played with like you mentioned. Some more about Chris Kelly's band. Where did they play? Do you remember some of them? Where did they play? Any special jobs that you can remember that they had?
Well they played over at the, they used to have a Bulls Club here.
Oh yeah. That's right down here.

On 8th Street. Played many times at that Bulls Club. Different bands played there many times. We played there. Played there several times with Jack and Chris Kelly and uh, and Rene at the Bulls. All right. And we used to go in Biloxi, Mississippi, and Peakyune, Mississippi, and Magnolia, Mississippi, McComb, Mississippi, all in there. Can you tell us anything about Chris Kelly's style? How he played? What he sounded like? I mean... Chris Kelly stuff playing now, the same thing. And I had some very good ideas about the Dixieland music, and there's lots of Dixieland numbers that I really knows. And they had some very good musicians at that time. Very good.
